repetitive_retry: Your previous answer became repetitive. Stop narrating process. Give one concise final answer only. Lead with the finding or blocker, then state the single next concrete check if evidence is insufficient.
textual_tool_call_retry: Your previous reply included textual tool-call markup instead of using the API's structured tool calling. Do not output tool XML or pseudo tool syntax. Either call tools through the provided tool interface, or give a concise final answer in plain language using evidence already gathered.
empty_response_retry: Your previous response contained no user-visible text and no structured tool calls. Continue from the current conversation and either call an available tool through the structured tool interface or give a concise final answer in plain text.
code_claim_retry: Your previous answer quoted or described code that is not present in tool evidence from this run. Revise: remove unverified code details, or search and read the exact code first. Do not infer handler logic from JSON/log fields alone. If unverified, label it explicitly.
raw_evidence_retry: Your previous answer pasted raw tool evidence or tool-call markup. Rewrite it for the user in plain language. Do not include <evidence>, </evidence>, <tool_call>, raw tool result wrappers, or long pasted output. Cite source references inline as file_path:line_number.
unevidenced_file_retry: Your answer references code files that do not appear in any tool result from this run. You may have read one file but drawn conclusions about behavior in a different file you never read. Before answering, read the specific file(s) you are making claims about. The same function name or pattern can behave differently in different files or code paths (e.g. a legacy controller vs a current service layer).
pivot_gentle: You have used several tool calls. Most questions resolve in 1-3 calls. If you already have enough evidence, answer now. If not, make your next call count — use the single most decisive search or read.
pivot_firm: You have used many investigation steps without answering. STOP broadening your search. Summarize your findings now: what is known, what is uncertain, and the single next check. If you cannot find what you are looking for, say so — do not keep trying variations of the same search.
pivot_urgent: URGENT: You have spent too many steps on this investigation. You MUST provide an answer NOW with whatever evidence you have gathered. Further searching is very unlikely to help and is degrading the user experience. Summarize findings, state uncertainties, and stop.
pivot_force: FINAL: Tools are no longer available. Give your answer now using only the evidence already gathered. Be direct and concise.
